visualCharacteristics.description: Flowing, wrapping row of brand logos
visualCharacteristics.source: Seven repeating brand logos that flow and wrap to a second row.

contentPattern.structure: Cell 1: logo image (alt = brand name). Cell 2 (optional): brand name, kept as a visually hidden label when a logo is present

reuseGuidance: Use for logo walls. Supply alt text or a brand name for accessibility.
